children: The data centre operator plans to deploy 461,000 AI chips, but only 5% are in operation. To justify a mooted $30 bln valuation the London-based group will need to complete 12 new server farms on schedule. With so much unproven, it’s an odd time to invite public market scrutiny.
Full view will be published shortly.
Follow Jennifer Johnson on Bluesky and LinkedIn.

London-headquartered AI cloud provider Nscale filed for a US initial public offering on September 18. The firm is planning to sell new shares at a total valuation of about $30 billion, CNBC reported. The firm was valued at $14.6 billion in a March 2026 funding round.

Nscale posted a net loss ‌of $1.02 billion on revenue of $140.6 million in the six months to June 30, compared with a net loss of $368.9 million on revenue of $10.4 million in the same period a year earlier, according to its IPO filing.
